headline: Lahaina Rebuild

meeting.summary: The board unanimously approved plans to rebuild a home and ohana destroyed in the August 8, 2023 Lahaina wildfire.
meeting.recap: Staff said the board must review the design because the site is in the special management area (SMA), which has its own permit rules.[[0:00:44]] The applicant said the plan copies the design and floor plan of the home that was lost.[[0:02:01]] The only change is that the ohana, once detached, is now attached above the garage so the home stays outside the shoreline setback.[[0:02:11]] The home is within 10% of the old square footage and under a 3,500-square-foot maximum, the applicant said.[[0:02:37]] A historic rock wall about 2 feet high on the property will not be touched.[[0:06:22]] The architect said the team is working with the County on dune restoration in front of the home.[[0:09:10]] The landscaping uses mostly native plants with low water use and drip irrigation.[[0:10:01]] The civil engineering plan keeps storm water on site with a retention area in the front yard.[[0:11:05]] No one signed up for public testimony.[[0:12:08]] Board members said they had no questions or comments on the design.[[0:14:30]] The board voted unanimously to approve.[[0:14:47]]
meeting.next: Staff said the board may give its design recommendations to the planning commission.

moments.q: Ohana moved above the garage to stay out of the shoreline setback
"It looks like there's unanimous to approve with recommendations."
